home.bio: I'm a Computer Science student at Purdue University, concentrating in Machine Intelligence and Systems Software. I build ML pipelines, backend systems, and web applications — and lead ACM SIGAPP as president while conducting research across three labs.

bullets: Led backend development for two large-scale student-run software projects with ~20 contributors each, coordinating architecture decisions, sprint planning, and code reviews.
Designed REST APIs, database schemas, and authentication flows for BoilerBuzz, a cross-platform mobile app backed by Node.js and PostgreSQL.
Architected a FastAPI-based grant management platform for Purdue PGSG, supporting submission, review, approval, and reimbursement workflows.
Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) using Keycloak, enabling secure multi-role authorization and multi-stage approval pipelines.

swe.org: Purdue University — College of Liberal Arts
bullets: Maintained and extended university web services by developing reusable templates and components using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Apache Velocity.
Resolved support tickets involving content updates, accessibility improvements, and legacy system maintenance.
Designed and deployed an automated video segmentation system that identifies pickleball rallies from raw match footage, reducing manual editing time from hours to minutes.
Built and optimized a YOLOv10s-based, motion-aware classification pipeline achieving 96% accuracy while targeting near–real-time, on-device inference.
Implemented an end-to-end ML pipeline including large-scale data labeling (36K+ frames), training, and cloud deployment using Docker, GCS, and Vertex AI.
Productionized model inference workflows to support scalable content generation, contributing to increased user engagement and platform adoption.

swe.org: Amazon Web Services (AWS) Youth Experience Program
bullets: Developed Python-based data processing pipelines using Pandas, NumPy, and scikit-learn to analyze wildfire risk through forest-type prediction.
Evaluated multiple ML models (Logistic Regression, Decision Trees, Random Forests, Neural Networks, KNN) to identify optimal features and improve predictive accuracy.
Recognized as a top 5 intern project for technical quality and clarity of analysis.
